title: refactor(types)!: delete nine Spec Report Bridge names nothing reads

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDjfmEr3MKz1q8Xz5W6ZahJ)_

Part of #25921 (batch 10, claim 6691851032 with amendments 6691892486 naming the branch and 6691972228 naming the batch; the card's other open items stay on it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从 `@object-ui/types` 的 `spec-report.ts`（入口上的 "Spec Report Bridge" 一组）删除 9 个没人读的名字：`SpecReportChart`、`SpecReportChartInput`、`SpecReportChartSchema`、`SpecReportTypeEnum`、`SpecReportAggregate`、`QLAggregationFunction`、`mapAggregateToQL`、`JoinedSpecReport`、`isJoinedSpecReport`。
- 为什么改：#25921 清理零消费者公开面；这 9 个名字在仓内与 hotcrm 都没有任何引用（只剩 CHANGELOG 记录行），其中 4 个只是 `@objectstack/spec/ui` 已有符号的改名转出，留着会被当成 UI 协议包的公开承诺。
- 风险与回滚：其中 `mapAggregateToQL`、`isJoinedSpecReport` 是运行时函数，dist 也随之删除；仓内无调用方，Console 与各 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响。对外部 npm 使用者是破坏性变更，带一个 `!` patch changeset（BREAKING、FROM/TO、ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` 9 个）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/spec-report.ts`（删掉的声明与两条 spec 导入）、`.changeset/25921-types-spec-report-bridge.md`（迁移说明）、`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`（按席位裁决 A 删掉两条 `JoinedSpecReport.blocks` 派生钉子，`JoinedReportBlock` 的钉子全部保留）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -lw -e mapAggregateToQL -e JoinedSpecReport -- ui/packages` 预期只命中 `ui/packages/types/src/index.ts` 的退役注释（及 CHANGELOG）；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/` 预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@object-ui/types` (its `.` entry) loses 9 names of `src/spec-report.ts`, the entry's "Spec Report Bridge" block. They are deleted from the module, not only from the entry:

`SpecReportChart`, `SpecReportChartInput`, `SpecReportChartSchema`, `SpecReportTypeEnum`, `SpecReportAggregate`, `QLAggregationFunction`, `mapAggregateToQL`, `JoinedSpecReport`, `isJoinedSpecReport`.

- `src/spec-report.ts`: the chart type pair and the `SpecReportChartSchema` / `SpecReportTypeEnum` constants go, with the four `@objectstack/spec/ui` imports only they read (`ReportChartParsed`, `ReportChart`, `ReportChartSchema`, `ReportType`); the "Aggregate mapping" section (`QLAggregationFunction`, `mapAggregateToQL`) and `SpecReportAggregate` go, with the header's "Aggregation naming" paragraph that pointed at them; `JoinedSpecReport` and `isJoinedSpecReport` go. The rest of the module stays as it was: `SpecReport`, `SpecReportInput`, `SpecReportTypeName`, `SpecReportDateGranularity`, `SpecReportSchema`, the `SpecReport` factory, `LegacyReportPresentationLike`, `specReportToPresentation`, `isSpecReport`, `JoinedReportBlock`.
- `src/index.ts`: the block's two named lists lose the 9 names; a comment names them (#25921) and where the four spec re-exports' originals live.
- `.changeset/25921-types-spec-report-bridge.md`: one `!` patch changeset, BREAKING, FROM/TO per name (the chart trio and `SpecReportTypeEnum` → `ReportChartParsed` / `ReportChart` / `ReportChartSchema` / `ReportType` of `@objectstack/spec/ui`; the aggregate trio and the joined pair → no replacement, with the one-line rewrite for the guard), and the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` marker naming all 9.

`spec-report.ts` is reached only through the `.` entry; no subpath entry of the package exports it.

## Tests

Seat ruling A (amendment 6691972228): only what pins a retired name goes; every other row stays.

- `src/__tests__/spec-report.test.ts`: the `describe('mapAggregateToQL')` block (2 tests) and its import go with the function; the schema, adapter and `isSpecReport` blocks stay.
- `src/__tests__/spec-ui-schema-reexports.test.ts`: the `SpecReportTypeEnum` `toBeDefined` line goes; the `SpecReportSchema` line stays as the control for the same assertion.
- `src/__tests__/report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`: the two derivation pins on `JoinedSpecReport.blocks` (`_joinedReportBlocksAreTheSpecReportBlocks`, `_joinedReportBlocksAreParsedTier`, their `PublishedJoinedBlocks` alias and `void` lines), the `JoinedSpecReport` import, the `JoinedReportBlockParsed` import only they used, and the header prose naming them. Every `JoinedReportBlock` pin (state, derivation, member) stays. The file is compiled by the package's `type-check` (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` lists it).
- No ablation: a deletion of exports with no tested behaviour left behind. The reverse probe below is the proof that the built `.d.ts` is the one read.

## Verification

<details><summary>Census (read-only, before any edit; origin/main 03067611, hotcrm 6961ab1)</summary>

- Tool: the batch 8 census (TS AST of every published `ui/packages/*` main entry; identifier-token index over every tracked file of both repositories minus CHANGELOGs, changesets, the lockfile and release notes; prose and tests count as consumers; then not taught in README/demo/docs and not named by a kept export's declaration). `@object-ui/types`: 716 entry names, 156 zero-outside, 54 candidates; `spec-report.ts` 10 of them. Note: this project's files `ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/25921-b10-census.md`.
- `git grep -lw` per name: every hit outside `ui/packages/types/` is a CHANGELOG record line (types, ui, app-shell, components, core); hotcrm 0 for all 9.
- Readers among the 9 are each other only (`mapAggregateToQL`'s signature names `SpecReportAggregate` / `QLAggregationFunction`; `isJoinedSpecReport` names `JoinedSpecReport`). No zod twin, not an arm of `AnySchema`, no subpath entry, not taught.
- Kept on rule 3 although the tool listed it: `SpecReportDateGranularity`, reached through `specReportToPresentation` → `LegacyReportPresentationLike.groupBy[].dateGranularity` (the tool's one-level proxy does not see the transitive reach).
- Positive controls, same module, same tool: `specReportToPresentation` (4 files outside the package), `isSpecReport` (1).
- No pending changeset names any of the 9; none of the 29 open PRs touches `ui/packages/types/`.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs on head 6db37048 (base 03067611)</summary>

- `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter '@object-ui/types...' build` (fresh worktree, no prior `dist`): VERDICT command-exit 0. Built `dist`: 0 files name `mapAggregateToQL`, `isJoinedSpecReport` or `SpecReportChartSchema`; the control `specReportToPresentation` is in 5.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (src, examples, and `tsconfig.test.json`, which lists `report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 387 passed (387), Tests 10460 passed (10460) (batch 9's 10462 minus the two `mapAggregateToQL` tests).
- Reverse probe against the built `dist/index.d.ts`: a scratch file importing the 9 names plus the controls `isSpecReport` and `specReportToPresentation`, `tsc --noEmit --module nodenext`: 9 errors (TS2305 / TS2724, one per retired name), 0 on the control line.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on a63b2a0f: 36 derived families, every line run with stdin closed, all exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172), after building `@objectstack/client...` and `@objectstack/formula...` in this fresh worktree first); `--ran` reconciliation: 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `origin/main` merged (9 commits, none under `ui/packages/types/`) → head 6db37048; the derivation is byte-identical. Re-run there with stdin closed, all exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt` (first attempt exit 3 while the dogfood build held the verify lock; rerun after it: exit 0, "0 raw tsc error(s) total"), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:nul-bytes`.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0 (0 anchored files). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), head 6db37048: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test"`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 428 passed, 3 skipped (431); Tests 3562 passed, 41 skipped (3603).
- Records: this project's files `ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/25921-b10/` (`gates-ran-a63b2a0f.list`, `gates-ran-6db37048.list`, `reverse-probe.txt`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Still open on #25921 after this batch: `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` (needs a test-support home first) and the other barrel batches. `@object-ui/types` keeps about 45 more candidates (`product-blocks.ts` / `designer.ts` whose census hits are reached through kept unions, `data-protocol.ts` 6, `ui-action.ts` 4, the `@objectstack/spec/ui` re-exports 7 and others). Census and tools: this project's files `ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/25921-b10-census.md`.
- `types/src/ai.ts` keeps its `never` tombstones until the sunset rule of #25912; not touched here.
